g.text: Two demonstrators, one task, very different motion styles

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Human basket demos (Aria glasses) retargeted to a Rainbow RB-Y1: A stays in contact 3.7× longer and moves the arms 2.3× slower than B.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Each dot is one demonstration; white bar = mean. Contact phase = first confirmed hand–basket contact to just before release, read from video

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: (ambiguous boundary frames excluded). Arm speed = mean RMS speed of the 14 arm joints. Same robot and task.
